subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) The grasshopper said, "Brother ant, give me a morsel of food." (b) Hearing this, the ant said, "Since you sang all the summer, it seems you have to dance all winter." (c) A grasshopper, his neighbour, passed the whole summer with joy without storing the grains. (d) In reply, the grasshopper said that he was not idle but was singing all day long during the summer. (e) In winter, the grasshopper was half dead with hunger. (f) On a frosty winter day, an ant was taking, out of his granary, some grains of wheat stored during the summer. (g) Saying this, the prudent ant locked his granary door. (h) The ant asked what he was doing during the summer. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (f) + (c) + (e) + (a) + (h) + (d) + (b) + (g) Section B : Writing Test
